svg.aria-label: Animated expected behaviour of the conveyor motor
svg.title: Expected behaviour of the conveyor motor
svg.text: Teal outline = that contact is true at this moment. STOP_PB is true while the STOP button is NOT pressed.
START pressed: the rung is true, motor ON
START released: the MOTOR contact holds the rung (seal-in)
STOP pressed: the STOP_PB contact opens, motor OFF
STOP released: motor stays OFF until START is pressed
START and STOP together: STOP wins, motor stays OFF
